patch_description:
This version uses a pressure-threshold packing formulation rather than relying only on direct greedy KVPR placement. For a candidate maximum KVPR `T`, each GPU must satisfy `load / remaining_memory <= T`, which can be rewritten as `load + T * used_memory <= T * GPU_MEM_SIZE`. This turns the objective into a two-capacity packing problem: every GPU must satisfy both physical memory and transformed pressure capacity.

The algorithm first builds several reliable greedy placements, then performs a binary search over feasible pressure thresholds. At every threshold it evaluates multiple transformed-packing orderings and retains the assignment with the best true KVPR rather than returning the first feasible packing. Finally, it applies memory-feasible improving moves and swaps to polish the best assignment.
